# A tiny web page. Each request fetches the orders from the backend, so the
# dependency is real and you can watch it work (or fail) in the browser.
import http.server
import os
import urllib.request

BACKEND = os.environ["ORDERS_API_URL"]

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        try:
            data = urllib.request.urlopen(BACKEND + "/api/orders.json", timeout=3).read()
            body = b"storefront got this from orders-api:\n\n" + data
        except Exception as exc:  # backend down, blocked, or renamed
            body = ("storefront could not reach orders-api: %s\n" % exc).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

http.server.HTTPServer(("", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
